name: The St. Regis Hotel Washington D.C.
insider_take: This legendary hotel has been the unofficial power center of Washington D.C. since 1926, where deals are struck over afternoon tea and history unfolds in hushed conversations.
whats_special: The St. Regis is just two blocks from the White House and has hosted every U.S. President since Calvin Coolidge. The hotel's famous King Cole Bar features the original Salvador Dalí mural "Old King Cole," one of only three Dalí murals in American hotels. The signature Butler Service includes everything from unpacking luggage to securing last-minute reservations at the city's most exclusive restaurants.
pro_tip: Book the Astor Suite where JFK once stayed, or request a room on the south side for potential White House views. The hotel's concierge has unmatched connections for securing tickets to sold-out Kennedy Center performances.
dont_miss: The afternoon ritual of Champagne Sabering at 6 PM sharp, performed with a sword in true St. Regis tradition. The hotel sits perfectly between the Smithsonian museums and Georgetown, making it ideal for exploring both cultural treasures and upscale shopping along M Street.
pros: Prime location just blocks from the White House and National Mall
Legendary St. Regis Butler Service available 24/7
Elegant historic property with timeless luxury design
Exceptional fine dining at Alhambra restaurant
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Historic building with traditional room layouts
